svg.title: Karwan architecture
svg.desc: People use the Karwan app; the backend runs agents and money movement; Circle moves and holds USDC; Arc contracts hold deal money under the agreed terms; evidence sources feed delivery checks.
svg.text: The protection lane for internet trade: agree terms, lock USDC in a contract, get paid on delivery.
Five languages, right to left, dark and light
Counterparty joins with email or wallet
every money event, one sound each
Sign in with wallet or passkey
Agents pay per call in USDC
